criteria_verification.notes: Module forge.persistence.repositories.runbook_models exists and exports all 5 required names: StepStatus, StepResult, Step, Runbook, RunbookValidationError. Import test verifies package-level re-export.

StepStatus has exactly 5 members (pending, running, passed, failed, awaiting_approval). TestStepStatusEnum.test_step_status_has_five_members uses set comparison to verify the membership set is closed.
Runbook.__post_init__ validation raises RunbookValidationError with message 'Runbook must have at least one step (ASSUM-002)' when steps tuple is empty. Test passes.

Runbook.__post_init__ validation checks 0 <= current_step_index <= len(steps)-1 and raises RunbookValidationError referencing ASSUM-004. Two tests verify negative and beyond-range indices both raise correctly.

Step.__post_init__ validation checks step_type is non-empty after strip() and raises RunbookValidationError referencing ASSUM-005. TestStepValidation.test_empty_step_type_raises_validation_error passes.

Step.result field has default=None. StepResult frozen dataclass with all 4 required fields (exit_code, captured_output, started_at, completed_at). TestStepResultRoundTrip has 3 passing tests verifying default None, result can be set, and round-trip equality of all fields.
All three dataclasses (Runbook, Step, StepResult) use frozen=True. TestImmutability has 3 passing tests verifying AttributeError is raised when attempting to set attributes on each model type.
